blockers.summary: Restart reconciliation treats a different terminal attempt merely ending in :op_ref as proof for a v8 claim with explicit attempt_ids_json bindings.

observed.result: Claim finalized even though terminal evidence belongs to a different turn.

blockers.sourceLocation: src/main-session/admission.ts: hasDurableTerminalEvidence() passes both legacyAttemptIds(intent.op_ref) and persisted v8 IDs to matchesAttemptId(); matchesAttemptId() accepts arbitrary event attempt IDs ending in ':' + a legacy alias.
blockers.impact: A colliding or attacker-shaped different turn identifier can cause restart reconciliation to replace a pending pre-effect intent with an accepted replay response without exact proof that the claimed broker operation terminally completed.
blockers.blastRadius: Restart reconciliation only. /tmp/g025-inprocess-alias-check.ts shows the live host's exact admission.attemptIds.includes check retained the same claim after the wrong event was journaled.
blockers.requiredCorrection: For rows with non-null attempt_ids_json, use exact membership only in the persisted aliases. Keep any legacy NULL-row compatibility aliases narrow and anchored as exact values; never suffix-match arbitrary event identifiers. Corrupt/non-array/empty binding must continue to fail closed.
